notes.title: The next game from the creator of Inscryption…
notes.content:
Friends, grizzlies, Mantis Gods, lend me your ears. I’ve been hard at work on my next game and I’m quite excited to show it to you.

[previewyoutube=f4IMwdCVbIU;full][/previewyoutube]

This game features much of the same madness that you found in Inscryption - weird and depraved characters, big gameplay / plot twists, and a rat’s nest of secrets. There’s even a card game in there somewhere.

If you want to be notified when the game comes out you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017940/Pony_Island_2_Panda_Circus/]wishlist it here on Steam[/url] or [url=https://www.ponyisland2.com/]join the mailing list[/url].

Thank you once again for your support!
- Daniel

notes.title: Inscryption V1.10 - Now on Mac and Linux!
notes.content:
Normally Unity makes Mac / Linux ports fairly easy but due to the scope and weirdness of Inscryption there were plenty of platform specific bugs to work out. Huge thanks to Ryan Lee ([url=https://twitter.com/belbeeno]@belbeeno[/url]) who single-handedly destroyed these bugs. And thank you to the beta testers who played the Mac and Linux versions and reported them!

In working on these ports (and a few other ones ːstimulationː) we came across some issues that have existed in the Windows version since Kaycee's Mod. The following will be fixed in V1.10:
[list]
[*] Fixed: The Trapper's Skinning Knife from Kaycee's Mod appearing as a random item drop in Part 1 and Kaycee's Mod. It was only meant to be available by purchasing it from the Trapper directly.
[*] Fixed: The "Blood Artist" achievement unlocking too early.
[*] Fixed: Rare soft lock in the Cave Trial if mouse-ninja'ing a certain way.
[*] Fixed: Pressing the CC button while fast-forwarding through that sweet sweet Lucky Carder footage caused the fast-forward visual effects to stop.
[*] Other minor graphical issues fixed.
[/list]
The incredible Mantis God cover art is by [url=https://twitter.com/CcrawlerArt]@carpetcrawler[/url]. 

And I'm delighted to be able to feature another piece of fan art for the patch! This one is by [url=https://twitter.com/aureolin24]@aureolin24[/url].

[url=https://twitter.com/aureolin24/status/1533428904035090432/photo/1][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FUfVTEAUEAEXI98?format=jpg&name=large[/img][/url].

notes.title: Inscryption: Kaycee’s Mod - Out Now!
notes.content:
[i]Kaycee's Mod is a free mini-expansion for Inscryption that hacks Leshy’s Cabin into an endless, and increasingly challenging, roguelike. Apply different skulls to your run to ascend the Challenge Levels. Reaching new levels unlocks new cards, challenges, and dev logs inscribed by the late Kaycee Hobbes as she uncovered the secrets on the disk.[/i]

Kaycee's Mod unlocks when you beat Inscryption for the first time. It can also be accessed via a cheat code: Shift+K+M on the Start Menu screen.

[previewyoutube=_ZEoVfMGgJM;full][/previewyoutube]

Huge thanks to everyone who participated in the beta! Thousands of bug / feedback reports were sent by tens of thousands of beta testers. It was a lot of fun to take suggestions from the community and watch their reactions to every patch.

This is likely the end of any major new content for Inscryption. Thanks once again for playing and creating a positive community around it! Time to get cracking on the next one I think.

- Daniel

notes.title: Kaycee's Mod V0.20
notes.content:
Wow, a lot of people joined the beta! There are some strong reactions both positive and negative so that's fun. I received over 1000 bug / feedback reports so part of my time today (and the task is ongoing) is figuring out a way to sort and parse all this feedback. Don't stop sending it though! It's a good problem to have.

This patch is mostly meant to address the high difficulty level that many players are struggling with. Kaycee's Mod [i]is[/i] meant to be challenging, but maybe more players should at least be able to clear Challenge Level 1 and start unlocking new cards. Today's patch will hopefully address this.

Kaycee's Mod Beta V0.20
[list]
[*] Added an extra row of special events (The Stones, Campfire, etc.) before every boss on each map.
[*] Nerfed the 5 most failed encounters according to analytics.
[*] Fixed: The pricetag for the Trapper's Golden Pelts not displaying the proper value.
[*] Fixed: Mud Turtle not being a member of the Reptile tribe. I am so sorry Mud Turtle you deserve better.
[/list]
For more information on Kaycee's Mod, check out [url=bit.ly/3oV1puq]this post[/url]!

Also: I'll never change the Misplays stat hahaha and I'll never explain how it works you'll have to decompile the game to find out hahaha.

notes.title: Inscryption: Kaycee’s Mod - Beta Open Now!
notes.content:
At the risk of becoming a broken record: thank you so much for the massive amount of love directed at this game! This mini-expansion is in part an expression of my gratitude. I have received countless requests for an endlessly playable version of Part 1 that emphasizes Leshy's deckbuilding roguelike as a standalone experience. That's what Kaycee's Mod is, and a little more.

[i]Kaycee's Mod is a free mini-expansion for Inscryption that hacks Leshy’s Cabin into an endless, and increasingly challenging, roguelike. Apply different skulls to your run to ascend the Challenge Levels. Reaching new levels unlocks new cards, challenges, and dev logs inscribed by the late Kaycee Hobbes as she uncovered the secrets on the disk.[/i]

[h3]How to play it...[/h3]
[list]
[*] To play the mini-expansion beta, right-click Inscryption in Steam, then select Properties. Find the Betas tab and enter the code “[b]givemeascensionmode[/b]”.
[*] Once you’re in the beta build, use the shortcut [b]Shift+K+M[/b] on the start screen to unlock Kaycee’s Mod.
[/list]
[h3]Once you're in...[/h3]
[list]
[*]Please report any bugs via the in-game bug report feature (accessed by pressing F11)!
[*]If you’d like to discuss the new mechanics, debate balancing, etc. head over to the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/danielmullinsgames]Daniel Mullins Games Discord[/url] and look for the  #kaycee-mod channels.
[/list]
[h3]What to expect as the beta progresses...[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balance changes.
[*] 2 more Rare Cards.
[*] 2 new Items.
[*] A final encounter for players who clear Challenge Level 12.
[*] The rest of Kaycee's dev logs.
[/list]

WARNING! You may want to make a backup of your save file before trying this.

notes.title: V1.08 patch!
notes.content:
It's strange to do this few patches after a launch. I can't believe how few major bugs there are and so again I have to thank the beta testers and the QA teams. Since I haven't had too many bugs to worry about I've been working on a little something that many people have requested. Hoping to give an update on that in the coming weeks!

[list]
[*] Fix for Guardian + Bifurcated Strike bug. It was possible to lock up the game when attacking with a card that had both those sigils.
[*] Fix for issues caused by winning a battle by using the Pliers for the first time.
[*] Localization fixes / edits.
[/list]

notes.title: Another lil patch: V1.07
notes.content:
I have to say it again: thank you so much for playing. I'm still a bit overwhelmed but I hope to reply to everyone who has reached out eventually.

More bug fixes incoming!

[list]
[*] I don't know how it was happening but some people were having their resolution saved to 1 pixel tall and were then unable to change it back through the game. This should be fixed now by ensuring a minimum resolution when the game is booted up.
[*] Fixed soft-lock in [spoiler]Part 3 caused by there being no valid cards in your deck for an upgrade (new ability, etc.)[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed for soft-lock caused by using [spoiler]Mrs. Bomb's Remote on The Archivist and then using the hammer to destroy all the Librarians in one explosive fell swoop.[/spoiler]
[*] Fix for some localization issues: typos/grammer/spelling and dialogue codes like "<size>" appearing for some languages in some places.
[/list]

notes.title: Second patch! V1.06
notes.content:
This launch has gone, in a word, swimmingly. Thank you thank you to everyone who is taking a chance on this game!

[list]
[*] The most common bug I'm still hearing is corrupted save files caused by crashes, power outages, etc. while the game is saving. Now, a backup file will be created every time the game is saved. And you'll also be given a message if you load the game with a corrupted save instead of just a broken Start screen.
[*] I also heard from people who use a virtual keyboard to play games due to a disability or for other reasons. The way the game locked the cursor within the window was preventing them from using their virtual keyboard. There isn't a proper option yet, but if you press Ctrl+Shift+U you can unlock the cursor from the window.
[*] Fixed a rare soft-lock caused by encountering The Mycologists with only talking cards.
[*] Fix for a visual bug after [spoiler]defeating G0lly in Part 3 - her boss battle effects did not disappear after the battle.[/spoiler]
[*] Other small issues fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: First patch after launch! V1.05
notes.content:
Holy moly thanks everyone for playing. Amazingly there haven't been too many bugs. That's in thanks to the hundreds of players who suffered through the beta version so you don't have to. THANK YOU BETA TESTERS. ːstimulationː

The most common issue was with achievements. This patch should fix that and will even retroactively award [i]some[/i] achievements. If you're still having issues after this update let me know in a reply to this post!

[list]
[*] Fixed achievements issues. If they don't unlock now, they will re-attempt the unlock when using Continue from the Start Screen.

notes.title: Inscryption is available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38503990/f3f2aae4f299cbe878905ff035907e90a628a1b3.png[/img]

Wow... Inscryption is out!

Thanks so much to everyone who has followed the game, played the demo, tested the beta, or left a kind comment. Your positivity powered the development of this game, from its game jam inception in December 2018 right up to these final feverish days of bleary-eyed bug fixing.

I feel extremely fortunate to have worked on something like this. I hope it shows :)

- Daniel
